Cyclestone provider authorization review
Provider: Codex CLI [codex]
Description: Exact file-backed Codex authentication without configuration, logs, or sessions.
Platform: linux
Access mode: read-only
Source: ${HOME}/.codex/auth.json
Destination: /home/developer/.codex/auth.json
Filesystem access: read-only
Forwarded variable names: none
Host service: none; transport=none; authentication=none
Credential strategy: direct-file-mount
Import: none
Synchronization: forbidden
Refresh: host file changes require session recreation
Revocation: stop the active session, revoke approval, and rotate provider credentials when disclosure is suspected
Backup: no Cyclestone copy; host backups may retain the source file
Security guidance: File-backed auth.json is required; keyring-only authentication fails closed. Read-write access applies only to a project-scoped isolated copy.
Project identity: git-worktree <PROJECT> device=<DEVICE> inode=<INODE>
Git directory: <GIT_DIR> device=<DEVICE> inode=<INODE>
Git common directory: <COMMON_DIR> device=<DEVICE> inode=<INODE>
Git evidence: object-format=sha1 root-set-sha256=<SHA256>
Grant duration: [o] allow once; [a] always for this exact project and request; [d] deny
